notes: label covers the skill's existence and name. category_label is added where the design document names a skill without stating its tier; those tiers are best-guess defaults.
From Extra tier up a skill is a bundle of named sub-functions. A fusion input may name a sub-function id (for example mimicry, a function of Predator).
active describes what using the skill does (same schema as creature attacks; damage is multiplied by the user's power). passive lists always-on effects.
capacity_cost overrides the per-category cost in tuning.json. Skills granted at birth reserve nothing.
Arts and resistances are not in this table. Resistances live in resistances.json; Arts get their own table with the reincarnation milestone.

categories.name: Extra skill
categories.what: One step up; the ceiling for effort. Power ranges from barely above Common to rivalling Unique.
categories.obtained_by: Effort, mastering an Art, species inheritance, evolution of a Common skill.
categories.label: CANON

categories.name: Unique skill
categories.what: One of a kind, born from the owner's mind and desires; anchored in body or soul; cannot be copied.
categories.obtained_by: Intense emotion, trials, crossing worlds; evolution of an Extra skill.
categories.label: CANON

categories.name: Ultimate skill
categories.what: Final stage; control over natural law.
categories.obtained_by: A Unique skill pushed past its limit, or fusion of skills.
categories.label: CANON

categories.name: Intrinsic skill
categories.what: Innate to a species; scales with race evolution.
categories.label: CANON

categories.name: Ultimate Gift
categories.what: A weaker Ultimate handed down through a soul corridor.
categories.label: CANON

categories.name: Manas
categories.what: An Ultimate skill that gained an ego and a name.
categories.label: CANON

skills.name: Predator
skills.label: CANON

sub_functions.name: Predation
sub_functions.canon: Draws a target into the body; works on living things, objects, skills and magic; far less likely to work on a conscious target.
sub_functions.game: Hold to devour. Certain on dead, downed or inanimate targets; on conscious ones the chance scales with EP and stagger. Can swallow projectiles.
sub_functions.label: CANON

sub_functions.name: Analysis
sub_functions.canon: Studies what was swallowed; unlocks recipes and copies; a fully analysed skill or spell becomes usable.
sub_functions.game: Timed unlock per subject; grants skills, recipes and codex entries.
sub_functions.label: CANON

sub_functions.name: Stomach
sub_functions.game: Inventory; later holds sealed beings and souls.
sub_functions.label: CANON

sub_functions.name: Mimicry
sub_functions.canon: Reproduces the look and abilities of an analysed target.
sub_functions.game: Each analysed species is a playable form with its moveset. Forms cost magicules to hold, less as you grow.
sub_functions.label: CANON

sub_functions.name: Isolation
sub_functions.canon: Quarantines harmful or unanalysable material and converts it to energy.
sub_functions.game: Turns poison and junk into magicules; the answer to hazards.
sub_functions.label: CANON

skills.summary: Devour anything, keep it, analyse it, wear its shape, and render harmful matter harmless.
